title: A Clash of Kings
author: George R. R. Martin
current_text: Alpine, Davis and Jordan school districts removed A Clash of Kings, triggering a statewide ban under Utah’s sensitive materials law.

sources.quote: Book two, “A Clash of Kings,” was banned Monday after the Alpine, Davis and Jordan school districts all removed it, triggering a statewide ban under Utah’s sensitive materials law.
sources.title: Utah’s list of school book bans grows to 34, including a sex abuse survivor’s memoir
